series.name: Blackwood Money Tales
series.bible: Blackwood is a vast jungle where animals trade and save with acorn coins (Rs). Drakon, a black wolf with scarred eyes, runs the Fang Lending Den: he lends coins at cruel interest and sends his pack to collect. Ragnar, a grey wolf and the last guardian of the forest, teaches everyone to save and spend wisely. Milo, a young brave deer, is the hero: his mother has gone missing and he owes Drakon coins. Elder Dev, an old stag, guards the forest's Savings Tree. Chintu the fox sells 'double your coins' tricks. Every episode is a complete story with its own money lesson, but the fight between the Fang Den and the guardians continues from day to day.
